name: Account switcher
description: Several ChatGPT accounts in one app: each kept signed in, and your chats moved between them between turns so every account's usage is used and fewer chats hit a limit.
author: Codex Mods
about: Add accounts on its Accounts page. Each signs in in your browser, stays signed in, and has its usage read. A chat keeps its history and settings on any account.

With "Starts new chats on the account whose limit resets soonest" on, new chats start there. With "Moves a chat to the account it should use" on (What it may do without asking), a chat moves between turns: soon after it compacts, to the account whose limit resets soonest; and right before an account runs out, the chats that were not just compacted move off it.

settings.title: Start new chats on the account whose limit resets soonest
settings.description: Otherwise new chats start on the app's own account.

settings.title: Move chats off an account at
settings.description: When an account's most used limit reaches this, its chats that were not just compacted move to another account at the end of their turn.

automatic.why: Starts new chats on the account whose limit resets soonest, and changes that as your usage changes.
Moves a chat to the account it should use between its turns: soon after it compacts, to the account whose limit resets soonest, and off an account about to run out.
